requirements.quote: This Specification covers the manufacturer, furnishing, delivering, and testing of a Metal Clad Switchgear lineup and its accessories for installation at the Syracuse Airport. The Metal Clad Switchgear and accessories shall be in accordance with the following standards and supplements: American Society for Testing Materials (ASTM), Metal Building Manufacturers Association (MBMA), Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE), and National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) Standards insofar as consistent with these Specifications.
requirements.text: The equipment must comply with ASTM, MBMA, IEEE, and NFPA standards.

requirements.quote: One (1) 15kV two (2) section Metal Clad Switchgear lineup.
requirements.text: Provide a 15kV two-section Metal Clad Switchgear lineup.

requirements.quote: BIDDER shall provide a schedule for the project with the bid. This shall indicate, at a minimum, the schedule for drawings, shipment from factory, delivery at site, overall lead time to site ARO, and schedule for field works. A more detailed schedule will be required to be issued from the successful BIDDER following award.
requirements.text: Submit a project schedule with the bid, including key milestones.

requirements.quote: BIDDER shall clearly indicate in a separate document any clarifications and/or deviations the BIDDER is issuing in response to the RFP and specifications. Only clarifications and deviations provided in this separate document and accepted by the PURCHASER will be consider to be part of the contract.
requirements.text: Provide a separate document for clarifications and deviations.

requirements.quote: Special Tools necessary for installation, testing and maintenance.
requirements.text: Provide special tools for installation, testing, and maintenance.

requirements.quote: Necessary drawings, instructions and test reports in the English language.
requirements.text: Submit drawings, instructions, and test reports in English.

requirements.quote: In addition to other Submittal requirements, final drawings shall be submitted as AutoCAD format files.
requirements.text: Submit final drawings in AutoCAD format.
Provide maintenance equipment and spare parts.

requirements.quote: Metal Clad Switchgear shall have eighteen (18) 15kV vacuum circuit breaker positions with protective relay and controls, two (2) revenue meter positions, two sets of (2) 15kV isolation switches, bus VT’s, and multi-ratio CT’s as shown in Contract Documents. Future bays shall be provided fully functional without the VCB’s included.
requirements.text: Switchgear must have 18 15kV vacuum circuit breaker positions and other specified features.

requirements.quote: Switchgear shall be Arc-resistant Type 2B. The switchgear shall meet or exceed the most conservative interpretation of standard IEEE C37.20.7.
requirements.text: Switchgear must be Arc-resistant Type 2B and meet IEEE C37.20.7.

requirements.quote: All necessary hardware for installing and testing shall be provided with Metal Clad Switchgear.
requirements.text: Provide all necessary hardware for installation and testing.

requirements.quote: Metal Clad Switchgear shall be mounted within a fully enclosed Equipment Building (by others).
requirements.text: Switchgear will be installed in an enclosed equipment building.

requirements.quote: The Metal Clad Switchgear will be connected to two (2) 13.2 kV feeders supplied by National Grid. Connection between the feeders and the switchgear will be underground cables.
requirements.text: Connect switchgear to two 13.2 kV feeders via underground cables.

requirements.quote: Separate utility incoming Cable termination compartment is required, that allows the utility to lock.
requirements.text: Provide a lockable utility cable termination compartment.

requirements.quote: Each phase shall have 1 inch diameter ground ball.
requirements.text: Include a 1-inch diameter ground ball for each phase.

requirements.quote: A 5/8 inch diameter by 24 inch long copper ground bail shall be connected to the ground bus at both ends and located 7 inches behind the door and 5 inches above
requirements.text: Provide a 5/8 inch by 24 inch copper ground bail connected to the ground bus.
